title: Omri Builds Samaria
description: Omri becomes king of Israel in the thirty-first year of Asa's reign and rules for twelve years, six of them in Tirzah. He buys the hill country of Samaria from Shemer for two talents of silver, builds a city there, and names it Samaria after its former owner. Omri does what is evil in the Lord's sight, more than all who came before him, and follows the sins of Jeroboam. After his death, his son Ahab becomes king.
